theorem book_of_proof_chapter_9_9_prove_refutation : ¬ (∀ (α : Type) (A B : Set α), Set.powerset A \ Set.powerset B ⊆ Set.powerset (A \ B)) := by
  intro h
  let A : Set Bool := Set.univ
  let B : Set Bool := ({false} : Set Bool)
  have hx : A ∈ Set.powerset A \ Set.powerset B := by
    change A ∈ Set.powerset A ∧ A ∉ Set.powerset B
    constructor
    · change A ⊆ A
      exact Set.Subset.rfl
    · intro hp
      change A ⊆ B at hp
      have htrue := hp (a := true) (by simp [A])
      simpa [B] using htrue
  have hm := h Bool A B hx
  change A ⊆ A \ B at hm
  have hf : false ∈ A \ B := hm (a := false) (by simp [A])
  have hn : false ∉ A \ B := by simp [A, B]
  exact hn hf
#print axioms book_of_proof_chapter_9_9_prove_refutation

theorem book_of_proof_section_11_3_11_prove_refutation : ¬ (∀ (α : Type) (A : Set α) (R : A → A → Prop),
  A.Infinite → Equivalence R → (Set.range (fun a : A => {b : A | R a b})).Infinite) := by
  intro h
  let A : Set ℕ := Set.univ
  let R : A → A → Prop := fun _ _ => True
  have hresult := h ℕ A R Set.infinite_univ ⟨by intro a; trivial, by intro a b hab; trivial, by intro a b c hab hbc; trivial⟩
  have hrange : Set.range (fun a : A => {b : A | R a b}) = ({Set.univ} : Set (Set A)) := by
    ext s
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨a, rfl⟩
      simp [R]
    · intro hs
      have hs' : s = Set.univ := by simpa using hs
      subst s
      refine ⟨⟨0, by simp [A]⟩, ?_⟩
      ext b
      simp [R]
  rw [hrange] at hresult
  simpa using hresult
